html:
FYI Yachts is thrilled to be part of the St. Petersburg Power and Sailboat Show 2025, presented by Progressive. Taking place January 16-19, 2025, at the Duke Energy Center for the Arts Mahaffey Theater Yacht Basin and Albert Whitted Park, this premier event is the Gulf Coast’s largest showcase of all things boating.

In partnership with NHD Boats, we’ll unveil the groundbreaking 325 & 365 NHD 2025 models, equipped with cutting-edge DS18 audio systems. Known for their USA-engineered innovation, DS18 ensures premium sound quality with components crafted across Korea, Brazil and China and select items assembled in the USA. These yachts are designed to deliver exceptional performance and luxury.

The show will feature everything from luxury motor yachts and sportfish to center consoles and much more. Explore an impressive lineup of vessels on land and in the water, and immerse yourself in the 40,000-square-foot tent filled with marine gear, accessories, and equipment.

Engage with seasoned boating experts, network with industry professionals, and discover the latest advancements and innovations shaping the marine industry. Whether you’re a lifelong boating enthusiast or new to the lifestyle, this event has something for everyone.
Join FYI Yachts at this must-see event to experience the best in design, technology, and luxury. We’ll see you in St. Petersburg!
